topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The news came in an email, crisp and official, announcing the inevitable. My apartment building, once a sanctuary of stability, will transform into a maze of condos. The landlord’s signature at the end of the message seemed almost apologetic, but what comfort is there in that? The halls, once vibrant with the hum of daily life, will now echo with the clatter of construction. Faces familiar as my own will fade, replaced by new ones, transient and distant. The place where I’ve hung my hat, where the doorman greets me like a friend, will no longer be mine. Change, I suppose, is the only constant, but the walls that have held my stories will soon whisper tales of other lives.
